item.title: Bulletin updated at 16:30 HKT 12/Jan/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The northeast monsoon will continue to bring cool weather to the coast of Guangdong tomorrow. The monsoon is expected to be replaced by an easterly airstream in the latter part of this week. Temperatures over the region will rise slightly during the day over the weekend. A replenishment of the monsoon will affect southern China early to midweek next week. The weather will become cool again with a few rain patches over the region.
